close_reason: MTA-STS HTTPS fetcher implemented with no-redirect+WebPKI invariants; check+clippy clean
description: Implement fetch_mta_sts_policy(domain: &str, config: &MtaStsConfig) -> Result<String, MtaStsError>. Fetches https://mta-sts.<domain>/.well-known/mta-sts.txt using reqwest. Security invariants (all mandatory): no HTTP redirects (reqwest::redirect::Policy::none()), WebPKI certificate required (no custom CA), read response body up to max_policy_body_bytes (64 KiB) then error, connect+read timeout from config, block RFC1918/loopback resolved IPs (SSRF prevention — resolve hostname, check IP range before connecting). Return MtaStsError::PolicyFetchFailed on any network error, cert error, redirect, or oversized response.
title: MTA-STS policy HTTPS fetcher
